front: Boost your eidolon's unarmed attacks with a status bonus to damage for a round.
back:
Eidolon gets +2 status bonus to damage with unarmed attacks. If its Strikes have more than one weapon damage die, bonus is +2 per die, max +8 with four.
Special: eidolon benefits from either boost eidolon or reinforce eidolon, not both; the newer spell replaces the older.
